title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Private House Testimony | TokenPost
html:
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agreed to take part in a closed-door session on his ties to Alice Huang, House China committee Chairman John Moolenaar said Sunday.

Moolenaar did not give a date for the session. Three House committees had separately requested a closed-door briefing with Huang for Dec. 1, but that requested date does not set a date for this appearance. The agreement follows a previous House effort to secure Huang’s testimony.

People briefed on classified U.S. intelligence assessments said officials suspected Alice Huang of passing information to Beijing and cultivating a close relationship with Jensen Huang. The intelligence findings have not been made public; nothing described in them establishes that Jensen Huang knew of the alleged activity or shared sensitive information.

Nvidia has said Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang reflected ordinary customer relations, noting that meeting customers is part of his role.
summary: House China committee Chairman John Moolenaar said no date has been set. A separately requested Dec. 1 briefing date is not confirmed for Huang’s appearance.
